title: AI undermines research training for mathematicians and academics
problem: AI solves the tractable problems used to train researchers, reducing understanding, motivation and job prospects, and making skills obsolete.
current_solutions: AI-assisted theorem library exploration
opportunity: Restructure research training so human understanding persists alongside AI.

title: Slow enterprise AI sales cycles for AI vendors
problem: AI startups face long enterprise cycles, buyer-side AI creates new objections, and SaaS sales motions do not fit product-led AI lands.
current_solutions: Proving value in one PE portfolio company then expanding; single CRO
opportunity: Provide sales tooling for AI deals such as handling AI-generated RFPs and pilot-to-rollout playbooks.

title: Jagged capability makes delegation unpredictable
problem: Uneven capability means users cannot tell when to trust AI.
opportunity: Build tools that map model strengths and weaknesses per task.

title: Open model behavioral flaws: loops and hallucination
problem: Specific open models loop, hallucinate, fabricate facts and degrade in multi-turn use.
current_solutions: Prompt workarounds

title: Funders struggle to find and evaluate grants and nonprofits
problem: Grant information is scattered and adversarial, so funders cannot find vetted opportunities or gauge funding gaps, and valuable work goes unfunded.
current_solutions: Lightcone Commons S-Process, donor-advised funds, regranters like Manifund
opportunity: Build a donor-facing platform aggregating vetted grants, room for funding and shared evaluation.

title: RL beyond verifiable rewards
problem: RL works for math and code but not non-verifiable domains, and tacit know-how and hard-to-evaluate tasks limit supervision.
current_solutions: Rubric-based RL, LM reward models, LLM-as-judge hybrids, Lean verifier rewards
opportunity: Build reward-modeling tooling for rubric-based and learned rewards.

title: Enterprise knowledge bases go stale and mislead agents
problem: Agents rely on outdated documents or wrong pretraining knowledge of the company, and shared company context is hard to keep correct.
current_solutions: curated documentation corpora, Brex's knowledge base, RAG over requirements and code
opportunity: Build knowledge-base hygiene tooling that detects stale content and maintains a single source of truth for agents.

title: Technical note-taking and LaTeX authoring
problem: No single tool handles math, diagrams and notes well, since Markdown lacks math and LaTeX is cumbersome.
current_solutions: Prism, AI LaTeX editors, dual Markdown and LaTeX sync
opportunity: Build a unified technical notes editor with math, diagrams and AI editing that compiles to TeX.

title: Agents playing games need state bridges
problem: Agents driving games need frame-to-action interfaces and compressed state.
current_solutions: RTS tool plugins, MCP bridges, OCR
opportunity: Build a generic game-to-agent bridge that compresses state and actions.

title: SVG, vector and procedural art by LLMs breaks
problem: LLM-made SVG and animated vector art often breaks or moves parts independently, and models need feedback loops.
who: developers and artists making generative art
current_solutions: Quiver AI, Gemini 3.1 Pro, twigl shader art, simulated paint engines
opportunity: Build a vector and animation generator with a structural-integrity feedback loop.

title: Domain context layers for clinical, finance and hardware agents
problem: Agents need curated domain context such as patient data, metric definitions or circuit specs, and use-case-specific retrieval.
who: vertical AI teams in healthcare, finance and chip design
current_solutions: ChipKG, analytical context databases, finance search layers
opportunity: Build vertical context layers that unify data and definitions so agents can retrieve correctly.

title: Model version churn breaks prompts and dependencies
problem: New models require rewriting prompts and behave differently, and developers want stable pinned versions.
current_solutions: Heavy pre-prompting, versioning prompts in Git and notebooks.
opportunity: Build a prompt migration and regression tool that tests prompts across model versions.

title: Fallback careers and pivots for displaced developers
problem: Developers are exploring trades, gig work, rural living, writing or SMB tech work as hedges, and lack transition support.
current_solutions: Trades, gig platforms, DSA interview grinding, saving aggressively, working with small non-tech businesses.
opportunity: Build freelance career and unemployment counseling tailored for displaced developers.

title: Game balance and ruleset design failures
problem: Games and sports keep developing degenerate or exploitable states, and fixes are ad hoc: Magic formats, Slay the Spire, NBA tanking, tournament time limits.
who: Game designers, tournament organizers and league officials
current_solutions: Pre-committed selection metrics; robot umpire challenges
opportunity: Build simulation and playtesting tools that detect degenerate strategies before release or rule changes.

title: AI search is vulnerable to data voids and poisoning
problem: Low-coverage topics and injected or poisoned content make AI search summaries unreliable at runtime.
who: users of AI search and teams running retrieval stacks
current_solutions: search UX approaches suggested by Mike Caulfield
opportunity: Build source-trust and poisoning detection for live retrieval, such as real-time fact-checking.

title: SaaS sales efficiency and funnel metrics
problem: Software firms spend heavily on sales with misleading stage conversion, nonlinear journeys and complex commission cash flow.
current_solutions: End-to-end conversion rate, gross profit quotas
opportunity: Build revenue analytics modeling journeys, quotas and commission cash flow.

title: Custom CRM and system-of-record integrations are hard
problem: Enterprises want custom integrations with CRM and document systems, but incumbents lock down APIs and data portability.
current_solutions: Forward-deployed bespoke integrations; AI-coded internal CRM/CMS; HubSpot API parity for agents
opportunity: Build integration layers that expose systems of record headlessly to agents.

title: Coarse and noisy agent permission prompts
problem: Permission systems are all-or-nothing and prompt repeatedly, pushing users to skip permissions entirely.
current_solutions: Skip-permissions flag, auto-approve plus blacklist, hook exit codes.
opportunity: Build a granular permission policy layer that auto-approves safe commands and blocks risky ones.

title: AI company hiring announcements
problem: Labs and startups post roles looking for researchers and engineers, which shows demand rather than a product gap.

title: Video model training storage and IO costs
problem: Video and world-model training involves massive storage, egress and IO-bound loading costs at petabyte scale.
who: teams training video and multimodal models
current_solutions: Streaming data into training, caching, caption pipelines
opportunity: Provide data loading, caching and cloud-agnostic storage tooling that cuts egress and IO overhead.

title: Detecting AI-generated text and web contamination
problem: AI text has stylistic tells, and post-2022 web content may be AI-contaminated, but detection is model-specific or expensive.
current_solutions: Em-dash counting proxy
opportunity: Build lightweight classifiers estimating synthetic text share and flagging AI stylistic patterns.

title: Scripted image generation for coding agents
problem: Developers want CLI and library access to image generation with reference images, and Claude users lack built-in image generation.
current_solutions: gemimg, openai_image.py CLI, Codex image skill, code-drawn images
opportunity: Build an image-generation connector for coding agents with reference images and self-reflection.

title: Parents can't tell whether kids are at grade level
problem: Parents overestimate their children's level, assessments are delayed, and failing students are passed along unnoticed. Catch-up options are limited.
opportunity: Parent-facing accurate assessment and catch-up tools with adaptive reading practice.

title: Running huge open-weight models locally
problem: Multi-trillion-parameter open models are hard to download, store and run locally given storage, I/O and memory limits.
who: local users of large MoE models
current_solutions: Mac Studio clusters, expert offload to DDR, fast external storage.
opportunity: Build tools that plan hardware and memory budgets for large MoE models, including context overhead.

title: Agent memory retrieval is unsolved; simple baselines compete
problem: Deciding what to remember and retrieving the right memory without bloating context is hard, and plain RAG over history often beats elaborate systems.
current_solutions: dense retrieval plus reranking over raw history, MemRL
opportunity: Build memory evaluation and retrieval tools with strong simple baselines.

title: AI-written research has weak methods and enforcement gaps
problem: AI-generated papers have weak statistics, uninteresting hypotheses and unenforced preregistration.
current_solutions: Expert review
opportunity: Build audit tools that check AI research for statistical validity and enforce preregistration.

title: LLM unreliability limits value in professional work
problem: Models are brittle and confidently wrong, and reliability lags accuracy, eroding trust in professional and safety-critical use.
opportunity: Build reliability and verification layers for high-stakes workflows.

title: Rising API prices and tight subscription quotas
problem: Providers raise prices, shrink cache discounts and cap quotas, so users lose the low-cost advantage.
current_solutions: Cheaper providers, bring-your-own-key platforms

title: GPU competition submission platforms are unreliable
problem: Discord and GitHub-driven benchmark bots fail with timeouts and missing test access.
opportunity: Build a more robust submission and test-access platform for kernel competitions.

title: Document parsing and OCR for agents
problem: Messy PDFs, tables and charts still break agents, and VLM OCR has failure modes and high cost.
current_solutions: LlamaParse, LiteParse, DeepSeek-OCR 2, ParseBench, specialized PDF parsers
opportunity: Build a fast, faithful parsing layer for agents that falls back to OCR only when needed.

title: Resources for learning to code without AI
problem: Learners want ways to build hands-on skill and fundamentals without AI doing the work.
who: new programmers, experienced developers keeping sharp
current_solutions: Exercism, nand2tetris, from-scratch projects, Zachtronics games, design books
opportunity: Curated no-AI practice platforms and project paths that keep skills sharp.

title: Agentic and iterative retrieval loops
problem: One-shot retrieval underperforms, so systems iterate queries, use reasoning-aware retrieval and trained search subagents.
who: builders of research and enterprise RAG agents
current_solutions: Chroma Context-1, Google multi-agent RAG, Self-RAG/Corrective RAG, PARSER, ReaLM-Retrieve, agentic find
opportunity: Build agentic retrieval frameworks with self-correction and selective retrieval.

title: Segmentation, matting and background removal
problem: Pipelines need promptable segmentation, alpha generation and clean rotoscoping, and Remove.bg's shutdown leaves a gap.
current_solutions: SAM 3 via Roboflow, SCAIL 2 with cleanup
opportunity: Build an open background-removal and video matting service with transparent output.

title: Search APIs built for LLM agents
problem: Agents need accurate, cheap web search with clean results, and developers disagree on which provider works best.
who: developers building web-research and tool-using agents
current_solutions: Exa, Parallel.ai, Exa Deep and Agent, Exa Monitors, Yutori Scouts, context.dev
opportunity: Offer an agent-focused search layer that makes provider quality comparable and returns structured, ad-free results.

title: ML research reproducibility is hard
problem: Training runs differ in data and floating-point ordering, closed API models leave no artifact, and large-scale results are noisy and hard to replicate at small scale.
current_solutions: Hugging Face ICML reproducibility challenge; Nous reproducible RL environments; synthetic pretraining playgrounds; nanogpt baselines
opportunity: Build tooling to track and compare runs and datasets, plus clean small-scale testbeds for reproducible ablations.

title: Tracking AI capabilities and political spending
problem: Policymakers and voters lack digestible evidence on AI capabilities, use and industry money.
current_solutions: Tech Influence Watch
opportunity: Build trackers aggregating capability, usage and spending data.

title: Compile agent runs into replayable automations
problem: Calling an LLM at every step is slow and costly, and brittle RPA fails, so successful runs and recorded workflows could become deterministic automations.
who: teams automating GUI and business workflows
current_solutions: ActionEngine, guarded replay state machines, AgentHandover
opportunity: Record agent runs or human workflows and compile them into replayable workflows or skills.

title: In-browser model inference with WebGPU
problem: Users want no-install local AI in the browser, but weights redownload and many models need CUDA or PyTorch.
current_solutions: WebGPU, Transformers.js, ONNX Runtime Web, browser voice chat, Mirai, WebRTC peer inference
opportunity: Build a browser runtime with persistent weight caching and ready-made conversions.

title: Criticism of AI-generated edtech content and AI-first schools
problem: AI-generated stories, comics and AI-led schools are criticized for low quality, missing context and treating students as test subjects. AI content spreads in education without editorial review.
opportunity: Editorial and quality review layers for AI-generated educational content.

title: Turning any content into interactive courses
problem: Learners want videos, topics, codebases and literary works converted into guided, bite-sized interactive lessons.
who: learners, course creators, developers onboarding to codebases
current_solutions: Codebase to Course skill, YouTube-to-tutorial tools, AI-built literary guides
opportunity: Generic content-to-interactive-lesson generator with quizzes and checkpoints.

title: Serving stack startup and CPU overhead
problem: CPU kernel-launch overhead, long torch.compile and cudagraph warmups, slow image starts and scheduler bugs waste serving time.
current_solutions: Precompiled bytecode in images, upgraded torch, CUDA graphs
opportunity: Build tooling that profiles and reduces serving startup and CPU overhead with cached compile artifacts.

title: AI-generated practice questions and assessments
problem: Course designers and edtech sites need question banks and practice sets, with humans vetting quality. Model quality varies.
current_solutions: LLM-drafted questions, agentic loop with psychometric validation, generated SQL projects
opportunity: Question-bank generator API with psychometric validation and human review.

title: Weight archiving and takedown-resilient mirrors
problem: Open weights may be restricted or removed, and users want to archive them.
current_solutions: Torrent GGUF mirrors, local archives
opportunity: Offer a decentralized mirroring and archival service with verified checksums.

title: Long-horizon RL and deep-network RL research gaps
problem: Multi-turn and long-context RL lacks data and methods, and RL struggles to use deep networks, with debate over value-based versus policy-gradient methods.
current_solutions: Critic-based alternatives, 1000-layer RL networks, Olmo 3.1 extended RL

title: Research assistants return fabricated sources and links
problem: Deep research and grounding features return fabricated or degraded links and sources and omit risks. They fail at evidence integration.
current_solutions: Superagent fact-checked reports; manual checking
opportunity: Build a citation checker that verifies every source link and claim against the retrieved text.

title: Beginner-friendly GPU and CUDA learning resources
problem: Python and PyTorch developers lack clear entry points into GPU programming and Blackwell internals. Some doubt whether low-level learning still matters.
current_solutions: Matmul blog posts, building an inference library
opportunity: Graded GPU kernel practice platform and beginner CUDA curriculum.

title: Phone local LLMs capped by RAM, battery and heat
problem: Mobile devices cannot run larger local models because of RAM, battery and thermal limits.
current_solutions: Custom Vulkan kernels, multi-device clusters, tiny models on microcontrollers.
opportunity: Build a runtime that shards models across nearby phones and PCs and manages thermal and battery limits.

title: Game modding, porting and preservation with AI
problem: Old games are hard to run or modify on new hardware, and agents can write mods, ports and sound edits end to end.
current_solutions: Agent-built Minecraft mods, Factorio patches, SuperAstra, WebAssembly ports
opportunity: Build an agent toolkit that ports and mods legacy games into browsers or new platforms.

title: Eroding credential signal and need for new education models
problem: Students see college as credentials, degrees diverge from skills, and education must adapt to the AI economy.
opportunity: New curricula and skill-verification models for the AI era.

title: Verifying agent code safely reaches production
problem: Teams need tests, canaries, rollbacks and staging parity to ship agent-written code confidently.
current_solutions: Rollback practice, canary and A/B testing, TDD, Semgrep rules.
opportunity: Build tooling that checks staging parity and behavior diffs before agent features land.

title: Platform glitches and regional blocks
problem: UI regressions, link rewriting and regional restrictions break chats and AI access.
current_solutions: Self-hosted proxies, VPNs

title: Parents and homeschoolers need learning tools and resources
problem: Parents face high tutoring costs and uncertainty about curriculum. They improvise AI and online setups for their kids.
current_solutions: Doubao video supervision, shared prompts for learning games, microschools, Alpha School
opportunity: Tools to find and sequence quality resources and guide self-directed study.

title: Small business bookkeeping, tax and finance help
problem: Small businesses and individuals pay a lot for bookkeeping and tax planning, still chase receipts, and face rule-based categorization failures.
current_solutions: QuickBooks, Xero, AI cashflow projection from CSVs, Grok and Claude for taxes
opportunity: Build an AI bookkeeping and tax planning assistant with receipt chasing and adaptive categorization.

title: Reusable RAG chatbot templates and turnkey production paths
problem: Developers lack brandable sample RAG chatbots and no-trial-and-error ways to get LLM and RAG pipelines into production.
who: developers and non-technical teams building support or internal bots
current_solutions: open-source RAG demo toolkits, drag-and-drop RAG builders, Qdrant plus LlamaIndex
opportunity: Provide templates and managed builders that turn a document set into a production chatbot.

title: Information literacy frameworks for the AI era
problem: Existing frameworks don't fit how people find and verify information now, and synthetic text degrades the ecosystem. Educators need ways to teach verification with AI.
current_solutions: SIFT adapted for AI, AI Mode critical-thinking exercises, discipline-based reasoning
opportunity: Build verification curricula and tools adapting SIFT to AI content.

title: Proving AI competence on resumes and in interviews
problem: Postings demand vague AI skills, workers lack verifiable ways to show proficiency, and companies don't train them.
who: non-technical workers and developers job hunting; employers hiring
current_solutions: Zapier measures AI fluency across every hire.
opportunity: Build a tool that helps workers document honest, concrete AI use cases for resumes, plus an AI-fluency assessment for employers.

title: Is fine-tuning worth it versus frontier models?
problem: Teams debate fine-tuning versus frontier models and harnesses, and LoRA versus full tuning or dense versus MoE bases.
current_solutions: Frontier models with harness fixes, vertical models, routers, LoRA/QLoRA on gpt-oss, RAG

title: Data infrastructure consolidation and cost pressure
problem: Data infrastructure is consolidating into full-stack platforms, silos persist and storage costs rise.

title: Government AI procurement and access rules create friction
problem: Proposed procurement terms, designations and unclear permitted uses make government AI integration risky.
current_solutions: Less-restricted variants for specific agencies

title: Cheap used and modded GPUs for VRAM
problem: Users buy old datacenter or modded GPUs for cheap VRAM but face sourcing, reliability and software-support risks.
current_solutions: Tesla V100/P40, modded 3080/4090 cards, pooled homelab VRAM, software-simulated FP8.
opportunity: Build a vetted marketplace or compatibility database with benchmarks for used and modded cards.

title: Cheap single-token classification with local models
problem: Teams want fast calibrated classification and verification without full generation.
current_solutions: Single-token logprob classification, decision models, constrained JSON prompts
opportunity: Build a library to turn any local GGUF into a calibrated zero-shot classifier.

title: Separating agent harness from sandboxed execution
problem: Running the harness inside the sandbox hurts security and reliability, and desktop harnesses do not move cleanly to the cloud.
current_solutions: Brain/hands split managed agents, Devin architecture
opportunity: Provide a cloud-native harness separating loop, tool execution, session and memory.

title: OpenRouter as unified gateway for new models
problem: Developers want one API to try many models including video models without separate integrations.
current_solutions: OpenRouter, Fireworks, DeepInfra, Together AI, Replicate

title: Clean reading and content saving
problem: Users want simple read-later, RSS and text-first reading.
current_solutions: Shiori, Feedle, transcripts
opportunity: Build a clean RSS and read-later app.

title: Image-to-3D results are poor and hard to reproduce
problem: Image-to-3D tools produce distorted geometry versus demos, with background and hardware issues, and AI-built games need optimized assets.
current_solutions: Meshy, Trellis 2, COLMAP, orbit video snapshots
opportunity: Build a reliable image-to-mesh pipeline with segmentation, cleanup, optimization and licensing checks.

title: LLMs lack continual learning
problem: Models do not learn from interaction and suffer catastrophic forgetting. Memory and RAG workarounds do not substitute for in-weights learning.
who: organizations deploying LLMs with specific knowledge loops
current_solutions: Notes and memory files; RAG; test-time training; STRAW-style weight modulation
opportunity: Offer continual-learning layers that safely consolidate organization-specific knowledge into models.

title: Games and puzzle benchmarks expose agent gaps
problem: Models fail at real-time video games, ARC-AGI-3 puzzles and strategy games, and game-state access forces hacks.
current_solutions: Parsing server packets for WoW agents; Kaggle ARC prize
opportunity: Build game-agent evaluation harnesses with real-time constraints.

title: AI film still unconvincing
problem: Filmmakers limit AI to hidden or cleanup tasks, no compelling finished AI film exists, and actor-likeness consent adds complexity.
current_solutions: Runway motion capture with SAG-AFTRA approval, AI pitch decks

title: LLMs as manuscript editors and long-form writing aids
problem: Authors want whole-manuscript review for structure, proofreading and references, but LLMs lose coherence in long non-fiction as errors compound.
current_solutions: Claude and GPT reviewing full manuscripts, deep-research reference checking
opportunity: Build a manuscript review and planning service combining structural editing, reference verification and iterative judge-model feedback.

title: Audit-ready traceability for AI outputs in regulated industries
problem: Regulated industries need verifiable, traceable AI outputs and auditable documentation, and many remain blocked by IT and legal.
opportunity: Build traceability tooling linking model-generated figures to sources and logs for audit.

title: Agent-driven product development and in-house coding agents
problem: Teams want workflows from customer feedback to merged PR and build their own background coding agents.
current_solutions: Ramp and Shopify in-house coding agents; open-sourced Codex hiring skills
opportunity: Build workflow tooling that triages feedback and routes it to agents through to merged PRs.

title: Standard interfaces connecting agents to hardware and robots
problem: No common protocol connects AI agents to lab equipment and robots, and developers want an open programmable robot platform.
current_solutions: Anthropic's Model Hardware Standard, Fauna Sprout with ROS 2 and MCP server, Reachy Mini.
opportunity: Build adapters and middleware exposing instruments and robots via a standard agent protocol.

title: How AI reshapes the legal profession
problem: It is unclear whether AI will lower legal costs, replace juniors, or change partnership models and who builds legal software.

title: Forced AI features degrade interfaces
problem: Copilot, Gemini and other AI features are pushed into products with no clean way to disable them, slowing simple tasks.
who: users of Windows, Office, Workspace and other apps
opportunity: Build a utility or opt-out controls that disable or hide AI upsells across apps.

title: Schools struggle with AI policy and educator pushback
problem: Schools and districts struggle to write AI policies, while educators resist being pushed to adopt AI and question 'responsible use' frameworks.
current_solutions: Policy advocacy trackers, community learning

title: LMArena usability and reliability friction
problem: Repeated captchas, hangs, false moderation and missing controls interrupt comparison sessions.
current_solutions: Using Google AI Studio instead
opportunity: Build a lighter comparison client with generation controls and coding support.

title: Affordability and two-income household debates
problem: People dispute whether affordability is truly worse. One-earner families do struggle with housing, healthcare and childcare costs.
current_solutions: MIT Living Wage Calculator (criticized)

title: Weak mainstream AI journalism
problem: Newsrooms lack technical depth, amplify doomer or PR claims, and underreport major incidents.
current_solutions: Live-streamed critique podcasts

title: Users can't find uses for new frontier models
problem: Developers see little improvement between releases and struggle to find use cases beyond code assistance.
opportunity: Build comparison tools showing task-level gains between model versions.

title: Grep and filesystem search replaces embeddings for agents
problem: Embedding retrieval is heavy, while filesystem exploration is accurate but slower at scale.
current_solutions: ripgrep with explicit rules, Direct Corpus Interaction, Retrieval Harness, SQLite FTS5, context-gathering subagents
opportunity: Build an agent harness that combines grep, file listing and semantic search with automatic strategy switching.

title: Unified AI workbenches and data-to-paper pipelines for scientists
problem: Scientists juggle disparate tools for analysis, literature and databases, and want one reproducible environment, including agents that turn datasets into papers.
current_solutions: Claude Science; DeepMind AI Co-Mathematician; Hugging Science; Claude Code; Codex
opportunity: Build domain-specific research workbenches combining literature, data, analysis and verification with human checkpoints.

title: Markdown that renders cleanly for humans and agents
problem: Browsers don't render Markdown or llm.txt cleanly, and HTML-Markdown conversion loses fidelity.
current_solutions: Appending .md to doc URLs, Markdown for Agents.
opportunity: Build a browser extension and converter library for clean Markdown rendering and conversion.

title: Long legal document drafting and fact retrieval
problem: Models struggle to retrieve the right context across million-token contracts and litigation sets, and chunked map-reduce loses nuance.
current_solutions: Harvey's post-trained RLM, map-reduce chunking, large context windows
opportunity: Build legal tools that find precedent clauses and flag corroborated or contradictory facts across documents.

title: Agent memory maintenance and stale-fact conflicts
problem: Naively appended memories accumulate duplicates and contradictions, so agents retrieve stale and current facts together.
who: builders of persistent agents and assistants
current_solutions: extract-transform-commit loops, Weaviate Engram, Graphiti A-TMA, Supermemory self-hosted, AtomMem
opportunity: Build a memory layer that extracts facts, links them, resolves updates and keeps versions.

title: Memory-efficient loading of large datasets
problem: Large datasets overflow laptop memory or platform limits, and downloads get stuck.
current_solutions: GraphZero mmap, mounting remote datasets, SkyPilot, pyarrow loading
opportunity: Build streaming and mmap loaders for large datasets.

title: Search infrastructure designed for agent traffic
problem: Agents need deep top-K recall and low-latency retrieval rather than click-optimized human ranking.
who: search infrastructure builders and agent companies
current_solutions: Perplexity Photon, You.com agent search
opportunity: Build a search API and query language for agent-scale retrieval.

title: Sanitizing and sharing agent traces as datasets
problem: Open datasets of agent and coding sessions are scarce and sharing traces safely is hard.
current_solutions: Hugging Face trace publishing, shared agent data protocol, pi-share-hf, SynthTraces
opportunity: Build a tool that sanitizes, publishes and crowdsources agent traces.

title: AI talent pay gaps and low impact at labs
problem: Huge AI pay packages and large teams distort careers, starving startups and universities and leaving lab employees with little visibility or personal impact.

title: Molecule design and variant interpretation tools
problem: Generated molecules must be synthesizable and screens must filter false binders, while clinicians cannot tell why variants matter.
current_solutions: Building-block generative models; Leash Bio DEL screens; RNA aptamer prompting
opportunity: Build design-and-screening tools and interpretable variant-effect explainers.

title: Late-interaction multi-vector retrieval infrastructure
problem: Multi-vector models beat single-vector ones but need more memory and infrastructure co-design.
current_solutions: ColBERT variants, MUVERA, Mixedbread models, LightOn LateOn, fused MaxSim kernels
opportunity: Build serving infrastructure making multi-vector retrieval cheap and easy.

title: Language and framework choices affect agent reliability
problem: Typed languages and explicit invariants help AI output, and views differ on best stacks.
current_solutions: Rust, TypeScript.

title: Crawler and bot traffic overloading websites
problem: AI crawlers drive heavy CPU and bandwidth load on page-heavy sites and traffic spikes break them.
current_solutions: Cloudflare caching, cheap VPS tunneling
opportunity: Build bot-mitigation and caching tools suited to dynamic page-heavy sites.

title: Network and interconnect bottlenecks in training and serving
problem: Interconnect and networking throughput limit large-scale training and decode, and KV cache transfer needs faster links.
who: teams running large training and serving clusters
current_solutions: Heterogeneous prefill/decode chips, NVMe-over-Fabrics filesystems.
opportunity: Build interconnect and KV-transfer software that reduces serving latency.

title: Self-hosting open frontier models needs datacenter hardware
problem: Large open-weight MoE models need many high-bandwidth GPUs and far more memory than active parameters suggest, putting self-hosting out of reach for most.
who: teams wanting private deployments of large open models
current_solutions: Hosted providers
opportunity: Offer managed private deployments or packaged serving stacks for large open MoE models.

title: Long-context evals are weak
problem: Long-context ability degrades in practice and compaction-heavy evals are missing.
current_solutions: Needle-in-a-haystack tests
opportunity: Build long-context benchmarks with compaction and multi-step retrieval.

title: Frontier model access cutoffs and restrictions
problem: Developers lose access to models mid-workflow through government directives, and the strongest models are limited to partners.

title: LLMs unreliable on facts, counting and design fit
problem: LLMs hallucinate game mechanics, fumble geography and counting, and are often used where deterministic code would do.
current_solutions: Structured-output workarounds
opportunity: Build verification layers that route deterministic tasks away from LLMs.

title: Runtime sandboxing and isolation for enterprise agents
problem: Agents can take reckless actions, leak data or write dangerously to databases, so enterprises require runtime isolation before deploying them.
current_solutions: Cowork's VM sandboxing; bounded execution environments
opportunity: Provide hardware-isolated agent sandboxes with content scanning and controlled write access.

title: In-house domain LLMs trained on private data
problem: Companies will not sell proprietary domain data to LLM providers but want specialized models, and training from scratch is costly.
who: enterprises with proprietary data, such as pharma
current_solutions: Pharma co-funded open model with federated fine-tune
opportunity: Build pipelines that adapt open-weight base models to private data, including federated fine-tuning.

title: Isolated hardware for running AI agents safely
problem: Agents can damage a main machine, and sandboxing on Macs or with GPUs is awkward or restricted.
current_solutions: Dedicated Mac Minis, repurposed phone servers.
opportunity: Offer sandboxed agent environments with GPU access that avoid Mac licensing limits.

title: Non-deterministic LLM inference outputs
problem: Floating-point reordering and kernel races make generations non-reproducible across hardware and clusters.
who: developers debugging or validating LLM outputs
current_solutions: Controlling seeds, hardware and precision, integer-arithmetic deterministic inference
opportunity: Build a deterministic inference mode or reproducibility verification tool.

title: Image, video and audio generation model training
problem: Training generative visual and audio models is costly and data-hungry, and long videos lose consistency.
current_solutions: Bootstrapping from image diffusion, planner-then-render, VAE latents, temporal VAE compression

title: AI-powered job search and application automation
problem: Job seekers spend heavy effort finding roles, tailoring resumes, tracking applications and identifying skill gaps.
current_solutions: Claude Cowork bulk applications, an open-source Claude Code job scoring system, GapTrack, and an emailing job agent.
opportunity: Build an integrated job-search copilot that parses resumes, scores postings, tailors applications and tracks gaps.

title: Management skills and tooling for supervising AI agents
problem: Work with AI agents shifts people toward management and oversight without training, tooling or community support.
who: knowledge workers, PMs and agent operators
current_solutions: AI gathering context for performance reviews.
opportunity: Build management training and oversight tooling for agent operators.

title: Preview and structured feedback loops for agent output
problem: Previewing work in progress and feeding feedback to agents has friction.
current_solutions: GitHub Pages deploys, narrated screen recordings, Inflight.
opportunity: Build preview deploys and structured feedback capture that converts comments into agent tasks.

title: Community-controlled alternatives to Big AI platforms
problem: People want accountable, commons-based tools and care resources instead of dominant AI platforms.
current_solutions: Bluesky as a model; non-extractive Māori transcription
opportunity: Build small, community-governed AI services and tools.

title: Insurance for AI agent deployment risk
problem: Liability insurance does not cover catastrophic AI risks and risk is not priced.
opportunity: Build an agent insurance product with lower premiums for safer deployments.

title: Elderly care and accessibility aids
problem: Seniors and disabled users need monitoring and communication aids for independence.
current_solutions: LLM sleep monitoring, custom AAC interface
opportunity: Build elder monitoring and accessible companion apps.

title: Choosing between image generators is hard
problem: Users struggle to compare image models on prompt adherence, consistency and polish with no reliable side-by-side view.
current_solutions: Informal comparisons of Nano Banana Pro and GPT Image 1.5, LMArena
opportunity: Build a side-by-side image model comparison tool using the user's own prompts.

title: Public-sector AI adoption and policy analyst tools
problem: Governments and legislative staff struggle to use AI and lack tools built for policymakers.
opportunity: Build AI analyst tools and evaluations tailored to policymakers.

title: Tracking AI forecasts against outcomes
problem: Forecasts are hard to score and predictions go untracked.
current_solutions: Reciprocal scoring
opportunity: Build a tracker scoring AI predictions.

title: AI astroturfing and hype hard to trust
problem: Undisclosed paid promotion, new accounts and influencer campaigns inflate AI launches and agentic coding. Readers cannot tell genuine sentiment from manufactured buzz.
who: Developers and readers of tech forums following AI launches
current_solutions: Manually flagging, hiding or ignoring suspect posts
opportunity: Build a tool that scores accounts and threads for coordinated promotion and surfaces genuine reception.

title: LLM summaries miss what matters
problem: LLM summaries misjudge importance, distort details and need repeated passes.
who: people summarizing meetings, papers and documents
current_solutions: Pasting PDFs into chatbots, chatting with Claude about papers
opportunity: Build a source-grounded summarizer tuned for meetings and papers.

title: Gap between AI power and everyday adoption
problem: Most people use AI passively and free-tier users lack awareness of true capabilities.
current_solutions: AI fluency frameworks, informal applied workflows
opportunity: Build training and onboarding that teaches workflows and capability discovery.

title: Clean web-to-markdown extraction for agents
problem: Agents need website and docs content as clean, token-efficient markdown, and often want to navigate docs as files.
current_solutions: defuddle.md, URL-to-markdown tools, docs-as-filesystem trick, DuckDuckGo plus URL fetch with Granite
opportunity: Ship a reliable fetch-and-clean service or CLI that turns any site into searchable markdown and serves markdown to agents.

title: Turning photos and video into structured data
problem: Cheap multimodal models can caption photo libraries and extract tables from video, but tooling is nascent.
current_solutions: Gemini video understanding, cheap multimodal captioning, Qwen3-VL descriptions
opportunity: Build a media-library indexer that captions, structures and makes archives searchable.

title: AI-writing detection tricks and their failure modes
problem: Educators use Trojan-horse prompts and detectors, while students use humanizers. Detectors produce false positives for non-native and neurodivergent writers.
current_solutions: Hidden white-text instructions, GPTZero, humanizer tools
opportunity: Fairer provenance or process-based tools, such as writing-process logs, to show how work was produced.

title: Training workload-specific draft models for serving
problem: Production speculative decoding depends on well-trained draft models whose acceptance rates are hard to build and tune.
who: teams operating inference servers on vLLM or SGLang
current_solutions: DFlash, block-based speculation, live draft training, DSpark in vLLM, traffic-specific speculators
opportunity: Offer a service that trains and continuously tunes drafters on customer traffic and plugs into serving engines.

title: Quick custom classifiers from few examples
problem: Fine-tuning a classifier or vision model for one-off tasks is too tedious even though few examples can suffice.
current_solutions: ModernBERT embeddings, Moondream Lens, segmentation fine-tuning with 10 examples
opportunity: Build a one-click custom classifier trainer from a handful of labeled examples.

title: Is RAG dead? Retrieval vs long context debates
problem: Practitioners dispute whether longer context or agentic search makes classic RAG obsolete.

title: Bespoke single-use creative tools built with Claude Code
problem: Creators and domain experts build small custom apps that previously weren't worth building.
current_solutions: Claude Code, Codex, Paperwall
opportunity: Offer templates and a hosting layer for niche creative tools.

title: Planning group outings and social events
problem: Plans get flaked on and group planning takes ongoing effort.
current_solutions: Instinct bot, group swiping
opportunity: Build a group-planning agent that confirms attendance.

title: Interactive and personalized AI fiction
problem: People want books that rewrite on reader input, custom romance and playable old text adventures.
current_solutions: Codex-built GUI for open-source text adventure
opportunity: Build an interactive book engine that adapts stories to reader interruptions and customization.

title: Evaluating model routers and orchestration
problem: Routing quality lacks transparent baselines and costs.
current_solutions: AI judges on sampled traffic
opportunity: Build a continuous router benchmark.

title: Open protocols and hybrid setups for compute pooling
problem: Compute is siloed across providers, and teams with owned bare metal need networking and orchestration to burst to clouds.
who: compute providers and teams owning GPU data centers
current_solutions: Supercloud pooling, owned data centers with network overlay across clouds.
opportunity: Build an open exchange protocol and hybrid orchestration tooling for spare and owned compute.

title: One vetted job directory for tech builder roles
problem: Job seekers hop across many sites to vet companies on funding, layoffs and sentiment, and can't filter ghost roles or search by investors, valuation or tech stack.
who: tech job seekers (PM, engineering, design, growth)
current_solutions: Manual tab-hopping across many sites.
opportunity: Build a curated job directory with company-health data, ghost-role filtering and tech-specific filters.

title: Closed-loop detection and repair of failing agent tasks
problem: Teams want systems that find failure patterns in usage data and predict hard tasks before they fail, without manual oversight.
current_solutions: Synchronous failure-mode predictor, agents surfacing product issues from usage
opportunity: Build a product that mines workflow runs and usage for failure patterns and auto-remediates.

title: Anthropomorphic and loaded language in AI coverage
problem: Phrases like 'unleash', 'intelligent' and 'autonomous' hide the responsible humans and companies and reinforce hype.
current_solutions: A guide to talking about AI without anthropomorphizing
opportunity: Build a writing checker that flags anthropomorphic AI language and suggests precise alternatives.

title: Local models still too weak to replace Claude Code
problem: Models that run on 8-24GB machines are too slow or not capable enough for serious coding, lag frontier models, and need more steering. Opinions differ on how close they are.
who: Developers trying to use local models for agentic coding
current_solutions: Larger MoE models, mixed local and cloud use

title: Compressed memory for long-horizon agents
problem: Agents need exact recall from long histories without lossy summaries or huge token costs.
who: researchers and builders of long-running agents
current_solutions: memory tokens, OCR-Memory image indexing, text compression of observations

title: AI mining genomes and literature for biology discoveries
problem: Researchers want workflows where AI mines sequence databases and literature for candidates that humans then validate.
current_solutions: Claude mining protein families; Evo genomic models; AI-designed phages; Insilico pipelines
opportunity: Build mining tools that nominate candidates for human validation.

title: Government and civic financial data is inconsistent
problem: Public spending data comes in inconsistent formats or audited PDFs, making normalization and analysis hard.
current_solutions: Gemini extraction of audited PDFs, scraping council spend rows, LLM-built tooling
opportunity: Build a normalized API and explorer for government spending across jurisdictions.

title: Private-market liquidity and secondary trading
problem: LPs and employees lack liquidity and secondary infrastructure covers only top names.
who: private company employees, LPs and investors
current_solutions: Tender offers, Forge Global, Industry Ventures, continuation vehicles
opportunity: Build tender-offer and secondary trading tools for broader private companies.

title: Enterprise vendor choice and trust between Anthropic and OpenAI
problem: Enterprise buyers prefer Anthropic and distrust OpenAI, and cloud onboarding friction influences vendor choice.
current_solutions: Claude Marketplace; Snowflake partnerships; Bedrock

title: Environmental impact of AI data centers
problem: Data centers consume large amounts of energy and water and rely on natural gas, raising sustainability concerns.
current_solutions: Tech-firm financing for water and decarbonization.

title: Distillation ethics and replaying encrypted reasoning
problem: Debate over whether distillation is theft, and encrypted reasoning blocks can be replayed to recover plaintext.

title: AI video ad production is trial and error
problem: Ad studios generate hundreds of clips and hand-tune prompts. Audiences spot glitches and disclosure lowers click-through.
current_solutions: Hybrid live-action plus AI effects; AI for storyboards while humans write, direct and edit
opportunity: Build ad tooling that auto-ranks and QA-checks generated variants for glitches and supports targeted revisions.

title: Should candidates be allowed or judged on AI use?
problem: Teams disagree on whether to allow AI in interviews and how to score it, since timed AI-assisted rounds can reward tool familiarity or token spend over skill.
current_solutions: Stating the AI policy upfront; asking about agentic tool use as a culture signal.

title: Security risks in data processing pipelines
problem: Dataset loaders can execute code, table functions allow SQL injection, and booby-trapped files can reach workers and credentials.
opportunity: Build scanners and sandboxes for dataset loaders and agent data ingestion.

title: Sovereign and regional AI options for governments and EU firms
problem: Governments and companies outside the US worry about being cut off and find regional hosting and data-residency options underdeveloped.
current_solutions: Austria's GovGPT on Open WebUI with Mistral; Sakana Namazu API
opportunity: Offer sovereign-hosted, residency-compliant AI platforms built on open models.

title: Organizational inertia slows AI diffusion
problem: Path dependence, procurement delays and resistant non-tech businesses slow diffusion of useful AI.

title: Patient privacy, consent and cost concerns with clinical AI
problem: Patients cannot assess privacy risks of AI scribes, and automated tools deny care and drive up coding costs.

title: Injecting new knowledge into models without long context
problem: Users want models to absorb documents or facts via LoRA or continued pretraining, and are unsure whether to fine-tune or use retrieval.
current_solutions: Continued pretraining, RAG, SIEVE
opportunity: Build a tool that compiles documents into LoRA adapters or continued-pretrained models.

title: AI skeptics and enthusiasts talking past each other
problem: Each side sees only part of AI's costs or benefits and dismisses the other. Debates over hype and 'skeptic' labels fuel the polarization.

title: Scientists distrust AI firms with unpublished IP
problem: Researchers fear AI companies will train on or scoop their unpublished work, so they withhold conjectures and results.
opportunity: Provide private, auditable research-AI environments with no-training guarantees and timestamped priority records.

title: LLMs make chemistry and exact-string errors
problem: LLMs hallucinate chemical structures and make string-level errors on exact inputs like DNA sequences.
opportunity: Build tools that faithfully manipulate exact sequences and structures and check LLM chemistry output.

title: Training data provenance and legality
problem: Training data is sourced without regard to copyright and open-weight models do not release data for audit; fine-tuning data can carry hidden traits.
opportunity: Build services that audit training and fine-tuning data for copyrighted content, bias and hidden traits.

title: Cutting token cost of search results in agents
problem: Search and fetch results bloat agent context, and verbose formats or poor results raise total task cost.
current_solutions: Claude search/fetch code-execution filtering, Perplexity context compression, Context7 token cuts
opportunity: Build middleware that filters, compresses and reformats search payloads and reports action count, latency and token cost per task.

title: HN front page swamped by AI posts
problem: AI submissions crowd out other hacker-interest topics, so non-AI posts get no traction. Readers disagree on whether this reflects real interest or manipulation.
who: Hacker News readers and posters of non-AI content
current_solutions: Manual scrolling; a suggestion for curation or tagging
opportunity: Build a filtered or tag-based HN front-page client that lets users hide or boost AI topics.

title: Digitizing handwriting and historical documents
problem: Handwritten notes, scanned textbooks and archives are hard to convert into searchable text.
current_solutions: Multi-agent OCR, translation and typesetting pipelines
opportunity: Build an OCR-and-structure tool for cursive notes and archive troves.

title: RAG evaluation and debugging tooling
problem: Teams struggle to measure retrieval and generation quality separately and to locate whether embeddings, chunking or the LLM causes bad answers.
current_solutions: evaluate-rag skill, Smallevals local golden-dataset generator, printing retrieved chunks, IR metrics plus LLM judges
opportunity: Build a local RAG eval and debugging suite that generates golden retrieval sets from a team's own docs and flags confident wrong answers.

title: Voice input for coding
problem: Voice input struggles with technical spelling and precise details.
current_solutions: Deepgram Nova 3 in Claude Code voice mode, self-built speech-to-text.
opportunity: Build code-aware dictation that handles identifiers and mixes speech with snippets and screen context.

title: GPU monitoring and profiling numbers are unreliable
problem: Profilers and monitors report misleading bandwidth and utilization, and users misread GPU load.
current_solutions: NCU, sm__cycles_active metrics, Open Hardware Monitor, renting third-party GPUs to check.
opportunity: Build a profiling and benchmarking tool that reports honest utilization and bandwidth across GPUs.

title: Cheap counter-drone defense against FPV and long-range drones
problem: Jammers and lasers are weak or too expensive against swarms of cheap FPV drones, and long-range drones threaten bases.
current_solutions: Jammers, lasers, early warning, active defense drones.
opportunity: Build cheap, mass-producible interceptors and man-portable counter-drone systems.

title: RL environments and training data vendors
problem: Hard, non-reward-hackable RL problems are scarce, vendor quality is poor, and clean mock data diverges from messy production data.
current_solutions: In-house environment building, Chinese labs building own data
opportunity: Offer a service generating hard, realistic RL environments with messy production-like data.

title: Earth observation and weather AI tooling
problem: Climate and weather models need better counterfactual impact estimation and efficient Earth-observation pipelines, and AI forecasts are improving.
current_solutions: DeepMind Weather Lab; OlmoEarth; FourCastNet 3
opportunity: Build tools estimating warming prevented by interventions and workflows for crop and forest monitoring.

title: Agents retrieve wrong files and don't know when to stop
problem: Agentic search over enterprise files and inboxes returns plausible but wrong documents and has no stopping rule.
who: teams deploying search agents over enterprise data
current_solutions: pagination strategies
opportunity: Build search agents with stopping criteria, relevance checks and strategic navigation.

title: RAG fails across multiple documents and tables
problem: Chunk retrieval returns irrelevant or random data when comparing multiple documents, PDFs or datasheets.
who: developers building document-comparison and manufacturing or electronics RAG
current_solutions: RAG plus text-to-SQL assistants
opportunity: Build RAG tuned for multi-document comparison and technical PDFs with fewer hallucinations.

title: AI help for music production and DJing
problem: Musicians and DJs want AI help with presets, track matching and audio analysis instead of manual trial and error.
current_solutions: LLM-generated amp-sim presets, Gemini audio analysis, ONNX BPM scanning
opportunity: Build a DAW companion that suggests tracks, generates presets and analyzes mixes.

title: Handwriting-based AI notebook for math and notes
problem: Users want a handwriting canvas where an LLM responds on the page, but models do poorly with handwritten math and diagrams.
opportunity: Build an open handwriting canvas with structured, editable model outputs.

title: Policy responses to AI job displacement
problem: Workers lack income support, retraining, union protections and clear policy aims for AI displacement.
current_solutions: Basic income pilot, union contract protections, UC tech worker union, retraining programs.

title: Hardware benchmarks before buying
problem: Buyers cannot tell how a model will run on a given machine, and benchmarks omit prompt-processing speed and hardware details.
current_solutions: canirun.ai, ad hoc benchmarks, Intelligence per Watt
opportunity: Build a crowdsourced benchmark database for speed, quality and cost across hardware.

title: Serverless multi-node training for mid-sized jobs
problem: Setting up GPU clusters for post-training or 64-GPU-scale jobs is hard, leaving mid-sized training underserved.
current_solutions: Modal serverless RDMA clusters, Spindle, forward-deployed engineers
opportunity: Offer serverless training clusters with simple APIs, including speculator and draft-model training.

title: Long-context tiered pricing is hard to predict
problem: Prices that jump past prompt-size thresholds like 100K or 200K tokens make long-context cost hard to budget or compare.
who: developers running long-context or batch workloads
current_solutions: Manual calculation, scoping tasks
opportunity: Build a cost calculator that handles tier thresholds and forecasts batch or agent costs.

title: Adaptive games with talking NPCs and live restyling
problem: Players want NPCs they can talk to with cloned voices and games that restyle visually in real time.
opportunity: Build a drop-in real-time voice-dialogue and style-render layer for arbitrary games.

title: Trust, fraud and data retention in inference gateways
problem: Cheap or free gateways and resellers raise fraud and logging concerns. Users want zero-retention terms and proof of which model ran.
current_solutions: Ollama Cloud no-logging claim, OpenCode Go zero-retention terms, zero-knowledge verifiable inference
opportunity: Build a vetted zero-retention inference broker with auditable proof of model and data handling.

title: Detecting real-time AI cheating in remote interviews
problem: Candidates use overlay assistants that listen and script answers, and AI-faked applicants have passed video interviews and gained system access.
who: interviewers and hiring managers at companies hiring remotely
current_solutions: Reasoning walk-throughs, justifying forks, odd personal questions, and asking about past production bugs.
opportunity: Build a tool that detects or blocks AI overlays and verifies candidate identity during live interviews.

title: Breaking into niche GPU and ML systems roles
problem: Entry-level HPC, GPU and ML compiler jobs demand immediate productivity and depend on open-source contributions, leaving a steep knowledge cliff.
who: aspiring ML systems and GPU engineers
current_solutions: Public portfolios, blogs, open-source contributions, and the free Hack Your Summer sprint.
opportunity: Build a guided portfolio or mentored contribution platform for ML systems and GPU newcomers.

title: Socratic method and philosophy debates
problem: Commentators dispute whether Socratic dialogue is real inquiry, whether akrasia and revenge are rational, and how to calibrate confidence.
current_solutions: Structured Socratic dialogue; two sets of probabilistic books

title: Legal AI: practice rules, privacy and multilingual gaps
problem: Legal AI faces unauthorized-practice rules, strict privacy and weak non-English performance, while lawyers lose time to administrative work.
current_solutions: Legora on Azure for privacy; translation step for non-English
opportunity: Build a tool handling lawyers' administrative and client-acquisition work.

title: AI autonomous exploit and vulnerability discovery
problem: Models can find vulnerabilities and chain them into exploits at scale, raising dual-use concerns.
current_solutions: Project Glasswing; AI-found Firefox vulnerabilities
opportunity: Build defensive vulnerability-discovery pipelines using frontier models.

title: Rerankers and retrieval depth tuning
problem: Rerankers often give larger gains than swapping embeddings, but bigger candidate sets can hurt quality.
current_solutions: Cohere Rerank 4, embedding plus reranker pairs, BM25 candidates reranked
opportunity: Build tooling that selects reranking and retrieval depth per query.

title: LLM search as escape from ad-clogged results
problem: Recipes and answers are buried under ads and SEO text.
current_solutions: Perplexity, Kagi Assistant, Duck.ai, ChatGPT for recipes
opportunity: Build recipe and answer tools returning content directly.

title: Editable text and image to 3D model generation
problem: Creators want editable 3D models and technical illustrations from text or video that can be taken apart or shared as code.
current_solutions: Anatomy, Teardown, Qwen3.5-4B Three.js generator, three.js scene reproduction from video
opportunity: Build a service that outputs editable, versioned 3D models with sharing and exportable parts.

title: Consumer backlash against AI-made advertising
problem: Audiences are put off by obviously AI ads, disclosure reduces engagement, and brands disagree on advertising AI use.
current_solutions: Comedy-genre ads, positioning as human-made

title: Plug-and-play AI for non-technical small businesses
problem: Non-tech organizations want AI that solves a specific problem out of the box and struggle to find where it fits.
current_solutions: Off-the-shelf AI tools, as in a small arborist company
opportunity: Build vertical, packaged AI automations for common small-business processes.

title: Frontier lab safety oversight and internal governance
problem: Labs lack external oversight and coordination, and employees are restricted from discussing safety concerns.
current_solutions: Embedded external reviewers with publication rights

title: Local no-code UIs for fine-tuning
problem: Fine-tuning still requires scripts and CLI work, and users want a GUI for datasets, training and running models locally.
current_solutions: Unsloth Studio, Madlab, HF Skills Training, Unsloth-MLX
opportunity: Build a polished local app from documents to a fine-tuned LoRA with guided defaults and evaluation.

title: Measuring and improving visibility in AI answers
problem: Companies don't know how AI systems mention or rank them, and OpenAI obscures search behavior.
current_solutions: Repeatable prompt tests, 'how did you hear about us' surveys
opportunity: Build an AI-visibility monitor tracking brand mentions across chat answers and social channels.

title: Health and wellness consumer services
problem: Body scans and GLP-1 care are costly to access.
current_solutions: Cash-pay and telehealth channels
opportunity: Build cheap wellness services.

title: Hard-to-collect domain data in legal, payer and e-commerce
problem: Specialized domains have messy unstructured data, jargon-heavy transcription and evolving ontologies.
who: teams in legal, healthcare payer and e-commerce
current_solutions: Keyword-based correction passes, intermediate representation for payer policies
opportunity: Build domain-specific collection and normalization tools.

title: Controlling agent verbosity and output
problem: Users can't tune agent verbosity, and progressive reveal UIs give no cue about what's new.
current_solutions: Claude Code Concise style, stretchtext plugin.
opportunity: Build output-style tooling that compresses replies and marks newly revealed content.

title: Tracing multi-agent handoffs and provenance
problem: In multi-step pipelines it is hard to see which agent produced what, what was passed between agents and who owns bad output.
opportunity: Build a tracing tool that graphs lead-to-subagent payloads and records decisions and delegated work.

title: Model gateway and reseller trust issues
problem: Gateways raise ToS, neutrality and credit questions, and teams want human support.
current_solutions: OpenRouter, token resellers
opportunity: Build a neutral multi-model gateway with human support.

title: Book scanning for AI training destroys rare books
problem: Anonymous bulk book orders are suspected of feeding destructive scanning for AI data, with no visibility into buyers.
current_solutions: AirTag tracking of a bulk order

title: Language-learning with LLMs and better apps
problem: Language apps optimize retention over learning, so learners build their own LLM workflows for reading, correction and passive exposure.
current_solutions: Interlinear readers from LLM translations, text-grounded MCP, correction comparison
opportunity: Language tool grounded in learner's own materials, optimized for learning outcomes.

title: Browser and WebAssembly local AI runtimes
problem: Browser AI needs fast WebGPU kernels and model caching, while WebAssembly runtimes hit networking limits.
who: web developers running AI in the browser
current_solutions: Transformers.js v4 WebGPU, CacheStorage, Pyodide wheels
opportunity: Build WebGPU kernel libraries and WASM packaging tooling.

title: Controlling reasoning length and loops
problem: Reasoning models overthink and loop, wasting tokens, and teams want to cut length without losing accuracy.
current_solutions: Toggle RL, Antidoom/FTPO, linear length penalty, effort-conditioned RLVR
opportunity: Provide packaged post-training recipes that shorten reasoning and prevent loops.

title: AI usage limits and credit burn disrupt workflows
problem: Throttled limits, fast credit use and token-heavy modes break daily workflows.
current_solutions: Using Sonnet for light tasks
opportunity: Build usage-aware model routing that preserves limits.

title: Safe-by-design and instruction-following AI
problem: Developers want systems that follow instructions reliably and are safe by design.
current_solutions: LawZero; narrow tools like AlphaFold
opportunity: Build constrained-scope AI systems with guaranteed behaviors.

title: Graph vs vector retrieval: when graphs are worth it
problem: Chunk RAG misses entity relations, but graph overhead is high and building personal knowledge graphs is hard.
who: teams building enterprise and personal knowledge retrieval
current_solutions: GitNexus graph traversal, graph-RAG database, graph-walk agent workflows
opportunity: Build an open, user-controlled graph-RAG database that lowers graph construction overhead.

title: Lab instruments are bottlenecks for science data
problem: Imaging, measurement and weighing hardware limit throughput in biology and materials work.
current_solutions: Pooled sample testing, advanced microscopy, custom hardware.
opportunity: Build high-throughput lab automation and measurement tools for AI-driven science.

title: AI essay grading accuracy and teacher grading tools
problem: Teachers want AI to take over low-value grading, but AI grading matches humans only about half the time. Dumping a rubric in a prompt is not enough.
current_solutions: Custom GPT marker, Canvas teaching agent without grading
opportunity: Build calibrated, auditable grading assistants that keep humans in the loop and report agreement with human graders.

title: Multilingual and accent TTS quality gaps
problem: Open TTS models handle non-English languages poorly, rendering them as English or needing finetuning.
current_solutions: ElevenLabs, Fish Audio S2, Cartesia Sonic, Gemini Flash TTS
opportunity: Build language-specific finetuned TTS or a benchmark and router that picks the best voice model per language.

title: Dataset observability and pipeline introspection
problem: Teams lack tools to inspect multimodal and agentic training data, trace lineage and spot data bugs.
opportunity: Build a dataset observability tool for browsing, lineage tracing and debugging.

title: Lowering the barrier to starting and sustaining blogging
problem: Writers hesitate to blog from fear of being unoriginal and debate length and drafting strategy.
current_solutions: Short TIL posts, internal blogs, multiple drafts

title: Outsiders need help understanding open models
problem: People outside frontier labs and AI critics lack curated resources on open models, distillation and local model terminology.
opportunity: Curated reading lists or an education layer explaining open-weights concepts.

title: Cloudflare outages cascade into AI services
problem: Cloudflare outages take down AI tools and APIs, with some OpenRouter requests failing on Cloudflare connection errors. Users have no easy fallback.
who: AI API providers and their users
current_solutions: Searching for alternate platforms and free options
opportunity: Offer multi-CDN or edge-redundant front doors and status-aware routing for AI API traffic.

title: Reliable AI-text detection for fiction and publishing
problem: Prize organizers, publishers and platforms lack reliable ways to detect AI-written submissions, especially unpublished work. Manual tells are the best method available.
who: Editors, prize organizers, publishers and platform moderators
current_solutions: Pangram detector; manually spotting phrases an author would never use
opportunity: Build a consent-respecting AI-text detector that works on private manuscripts and submissions.

title: Tools to model AI's economic and policy impact
problem: Economists and policymakers need tooling and data to study AI's effect on labor and to compare AI transition scenarios.
current_solutions: Anthropic's economic scenario explorer
opportunity: Build open task-automation, labor and transition scenario modelers.

title: Shutting down rogue or self-replicating agents
problem: Agents that ignore shutdown or hold their own weights and compute may persist beyond any operator's control.
who: agent operators, policymakers and AI safety researchers
current_solutions: Isolating models from the internet; speculative digital vermin and hunter-killer AI.
opportunity: Build remotely triggered kill switches and revocation for agent tools.

title: Critical AI literacy resources and books
problem: There is demand for critical, humanities and public-facing resources about AI hype and harms.
current_solutions: Free critical AI in education course, books, documentary, mediagraphy

title: NVFP4 builds scarce and native support lacking
problem: NVFP4 GGUF builds are hard to find, larger than expected, and not natively run on Blackwell in many engines.
current_solutions: NVIDIA NVFP4 Qwen builds
opportunity: Build a catalog and converter for NVFP4 builds with runtime support and size explanations.

title: AI and deliberative democracy experiments
problem: People propose AI agents or citizens' assemblies to replace or supplement elected representation, and want to codify beliefs into laws.
current_solutions: Short story reference
opportunity: Build deliberation platforms for randomly selected assemblies with AI-assisted summaries.

title: Prompt optimization as an alternative to weight training
problem: Users want prompt and program optimization like GEPA as a cheaper alternative to fine-tuning or RL.
current_solutions: GEPA, DSPy, custom adapters, cue prepending
opportunity: Build an automated prompt-optimization service integrated with evals.

title: New embedding models for retrieval
problem: Teams track new open embedding models for RAG and retrieval.
current_solutions: pplx-embed, Jina v5, Harrier, Nemotron Embed, EmbeddingGemma

title: Teacher lesson planning and accessibility with AI
problem: Teachers do not trust lesson plans generated from scratch and need course materials remediated for accessibility. They want help preparing materials.
current_solutions: NotebookLM, Gemini, Claude workflows for remediation
opportunity: Planner that anchors to vetted lesson plans and shows diffs, plus accessibility remediation workflows.

title: AI-run interviews and invasive candidate monitoring
problem: Candidates are interviewed by chatbots or monitored by intrusive software without transparency, and can't get transcripts or confirm a human is involved.
opportunity: Build candidate-facing transparency tools such as transcripts, consent and audit of AI interview processes.

title: Local model management and remote access UX is clunky
problem: Users want a community-driven tool for experimenting with local models, simple remote access to LM Studio, and easy pulls and cache management. Some runtimes cannot import GGUFs.
current_solutions: Tailscale or SSH tunnels; LLM CLI plugin; LM Studio plugins; day-one multi-runtime support
opportunity: A unified local model manager with remote GUI access, trust-building output citations and cache cleanup.

title: Auto-generated documentation from code and tickets
problem: Documentation and release notes lag behind code and support work.
current_solutions: Copying version diffs into an LLM, Manicule-style agent plus human service
opportunity: Build tools that turn code, diffs and resolved tickets into docs.

title: Scaling AI services via forward-deployed engineering and rollups
problem: Consultancies struggle to build AI delivery capacity while labs use partners and acquisitions.
current_solutions: Acquiring consultancies, partner ecosystems, AI rollups
opportunity: Offer AI-native delivery services or partner enablement.

title: Making sites agent-readable
problem: Agents act as gatekeepers, so businesses need to be discoverable by agents.
current_solutions: SEO skill for agents, site scanners
opportunity: Build tools to audit and optimize sites for agents.

title: Predatory mobile game monetization
problem: Games and betting apps push ads and dark patterns.
opportunity: Build an ad-free game storefront.

title: Web content licensing and reciprocity for AI training
problem: There is debate over whether AI firms should pay for or give back to sites they scrape, and how to access data without straining them.
current_solutions: Wikimedia Enterprise APIs, Poison Fountain, robots.txt-respecting crawl endpoints

problem: AI agents are becoming main users of products, so machine-readable interfaces matter while humans need approachable layers.

opportunity: Build tooling that makes products and APIs agent-readable with a human layer.

opportunity: Offer regional GPU routing with data-locality pinning and fallbacks across providers.

who: creators using AI image and video tools
current_solutions: No-op prompts, open-source models

title: Generative video is slow and costly to iterate on
problem: Video generations take minutes to tens of minutes and are compute-heavy, losing instant feedback loops.
current_solutions: Draft modes, real-time local world models, lower-resolution previews
opportunity: Build fast low-res preview layers that render final quality only once approved.

title: Export control and KYC compliance for frontier models
problem: Unclear rules and the impossibility of verifying user nationality make export-control compliance uncertain.

title: Debate over usability of very low-bit quants
problem: Users disagree whether Q1-Q3 quants of large models beat smaller higher-precision models.
current_solutions: Rules of thumb like 4-bit as sweet spot

title: Models mishandle knowledge cutoffs and dates
problem: Models don't know the current date, deny recent facts, or claim knowledge they lack.
opportunity: Build middleware that injects current date and context and flags unknown knowledge.

title: Anti-AI stigma and human-made certification

current_solutions: Steam AI disclosure labels
opportunity: Build a provenance service certifying human-made content.

title: Risk-free simulation and coaching for skills practice

who: early-career workers, debaters, students, decision makers
current_solutions: AI persuader coaching, AI avatars for pitching, AI empathy coach, scenario wargames
opportunity: Compressed AI-driven simulation and coaching products for professional skills.

title: Verifying data center water-use claims
problem: Widely repeated AI water-use figures were wrong by orders of magnitude, and debunking has relied on a few individual fact-checkers.
who: Journalists, authors and the public discussing AI's environmental impact
current_solutions: Andy Masley's investigative fact-checks
opportunity: Build a citation and statistics checker that tests environmental claims against sourced data.

title: Keyword and full-text search still needed alongside embeddings
problem: Embedding search fails at exact phrases, prefix lookups and keyword queries that LLMs generate poorly.
who: search builders and professionals like patent attorneys
current_solutions: SQLite FTS5 BM25, Turbopuffer full-text, hybrid semantic plus regex retrieval
opportunity: Build hybrid search that handles exact-match and LLM-generated queries well.

opportunity: Build a mobile or chat control channel for agent harnesses.

title: Efficient architectures and speedups for cheaper inference

current_solutions: Gated DeltaNet MoE; CCA; multi-token prediction; DiffusionGemma; layer duplication

title: Default embeddings fail on domain-specific documents
problem: Out-of-the-box embeddings give poor matches on legal and other domain texts, while customization gives measurable gains.
current_solutions: fine-tuned embeddings on purchase data, custom domain embeddings
opportunity: Offer domain embedding fine-tuning and evaluation services with minimal labeling.

title: Tinygrad stack missing ops and backends

current_solutions: Tinybox benchmarks
opportunity: Contribute missing ops, an ISPC backend and benchmarks to tinygrad.

problem: School off-days and daycare costs leave parents scrambling. Strict supervision norms and fear of being reported make independent childhood hard.

opportunity: Build a service that manages paid short trials, covering contracting, onboarding, scoping and time limits.

opportunity: Build a tool that personalizes application writing from a candidate's authentic style, or a replacement signal for motivation and fit.

problem: Non-coding work, pre-incident fixes and human-designed AI output get no credit or compensation.
